info.title: Stream Recorder API
info.description: Versioned API for all server-side GUI operations. Browser sessions retain role checks and CSRF; bearer keys need the operation permission. Operator and Administrator scopes are described in docs/gui-api-parity.md. Existing /api routes remain compatible aliases unless a route is explicitly v1-only. Recording start and upload enqueue support persisted caller-scoped idempotency. Browser-local theme is not shared state; Google consent remains interactive. The security schemes describe supported credentials when access control is enabled; deployments with optional authentication may allow local access. State-changing browser-session requests require X-CSRF-Token, while bearer-key requests are validated against the key permissions.

put.description: Masked secret fields in responses never contain credentials. Omitted secrets retain their saved values.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: True when this response replays an existing admission.

post.description: Starts one recording if admission succeeds. Idempotency-Key is caller-scoped and persisted: identical payloads replay the original 201 response; reusing a key with a different payload returns 409 idempotency_conflict. Mappings currently do not expire. A concurrent different key can receive 409 conflict.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Visible ASCII. Same caller/key and payload replays the admission; a different payload conflicts.

post.description: Compatibility operation for clients that do not retain a recording ID. Prefer POST /api/v1/recordings/{id}/stop so a delayed retry cannot stop a later recording.

patch.x-permission: Field-sensitive: recordings:pin, recordings:title, recordings:start for automatic-upload overrides.
patch.description: PATCH accepts pinned, title, and (while capture is active) auto_upload/upload_metadata overrides. Scoped keys need the permission for every field in the same request.
